changelog: Fixed home discovery images and 404 episode guard
Corrected cover-title pairing (local poster images for list cards, exact MAL matching for hero cards)
HLS playback through the session proxy now serves .ts/.m3u8 URL paths so strict players accept disguised .jpg segments

Fixed live playback regression: genuine An1me streams disguise real MPEG-TS segments as .jpg files and were wrongly rejected as image slideshows; the check now trusts masters advertising real video codecs/resolutions
Fixed episode details title to strip the Greek 'Παρακολουθήστε' (Watch) prefix
Fixed empty episode lists: multi-season/franchise shows (Pokemon) now load episodes via the site AJAX API, and movies resolve their bare watch URL
Stream routes are now range-probed before returning: dead Google Photos and expired wetransfer links are dropped, and the site's reliable An1 HLS server is preferred
Replaced the fixed 54-episode placeholder with the complete ordered One Pace watch-list catalogue
Preserved compatibility with previously saved onepace-index episode links
Retained sub/dub metadata and multi-quality stream resolution
Drop dead Videasy/moon/ironwallnet routes when LookMovie/refligns work — fixes app StreamRace picking broken 1080p
Score LookMovie/refligns higher; demote fragile Videasy hosts until probe OK
TMDB multi-search fallback when freehost search flakes
Evil Dead Burn / Inception / Dune / John Wick: primary route segment verified MP2T
